method.purpose: Source-bound characterization of Jev-Mem's write/admission and consolidation decisions; the model step is scripted, not executed.

controller.note: Scripted numeric defaults are 0.9 except listed zero-default control; coverage-token questions default to zero; per-case overrides take precedence. Choice uses the stated selection probability. These are supplied values, not model predictions.

method.determinism: Real UUIDs remain in upstream execution. Receipt-only labels n1, n2 ... follow build order and replace all node references, including persisted decisions and summary provenance. Link UUIDs and internal dedup hashes are omitted; typed endpoints and relations are retained. Fixture timestamps are fixed; a generated summary has no supplied timestamp.
method.minimum_runtime: numpy, networkx, tqdm (upstream's declared deps). No typesafe-sdk, faiss or sentence-transformers needed.

notes: A high obsolete probability is a returned judgement about the new/candidate pair, not a deletion.
The encoder is upstream's MockEncoder; candidate selection is not a real semantic-retrieval result.
No scalar in this receipt measures a model's semantic ability.

source.commit_subject: Add Hugging Face Paper badge to README

substituted.replaces: typesafe_sdk Noul / Choice / ChoiceAnswer / error classes
substituted.why: The SDK is not installed and must not be installed; the model step is scripted. Question payloads still come from the real jev_questions.py.
No online model, network or credentials. Scripted answers carry the same Noul float / ChoiceAnswer shape the real jev_mock path produces.

substituted.boundary: deterministic node labels in the receipt
substituted.replaces: the runtime uuid4 node ids inside the receipt only
substituted.why: Upstream EventNode keeps its real uuid4 ids end-to-end; the runner maps each runtime id to n1, n2 ... in creation order and reports those labels. The mapping is applied to the snapshot output, never to the executed source, so no upstream behaviour depends on it.
memory_builder / trg_memory import it at module scope; it is never used because llm_enabled=False; its constructor raises if reached.
The callback joins the two source strings and records its inputs; it does not call a model.
